description: This file defines a React context provider for managing user sessions in a Solana-based wallet connection. It handles session loading, wallet connection/disconnection, and provides session state and actions to the rest of the app.

methods.name: Providers
methods.description: React component that provides session context to its children, managing session state including loading, connecting, and disconnecting wallets.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects a wallet for a specific user role, establishing a session and saving it.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the wallet and clears the current session.
